mission: Buy one adult ticket for Saturday's match

frames.caption: Margaret opens the fixtures page. The browser server has already applied her iPad, touch screen and 150% text.
A cookie banner covers the page. The only way out is a tiny "ok" in the corner.
She chooses Saturday's match and waits for the seat map.
Seat A1 looks available. It is rejected and she is sent back to the fixtures list.
Second try: row B, seat 5. Checkout opens.
She types the card number as printed: 4242 4242 4242 4242.
The field silently cut it off at 16 characters, and the security code box has no label.
Pay now. 7.5 seconds with no sign anything is happening.
Order confirmed, but £29.50 was taken for a £27.00 ticket. No fee was shown before paying.

frames.title: Outcome: success
lines: Decided by the server, not the persona
The full cast found 12 of 15 planted flaws
